easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
description:
Cast a copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Emeritus of Truce.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares.
When Emeritus of Truce enters, it triggers, causing a player to create a 1/1 Inkling creature with flying, then becoming prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

uses.name: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares
